provenance.implementation: New Rust implementation of the C# boundary/budget behavior. No source inclusion or dependency on another candidate. Root MIT license applies.
provenance.api_reference: PR33 90eafe0b4dcda137e90c78685b64abefa6f33357 experiments/rust-typed-deflate/src/typed_deflate.rs and cached zlib-rs 0.6.8 public API
differences_from_pr33: No ZIP/JSON/base64, crc32fast, cfg-if, path source inclusion, provisional sink or expected ZIP size
Actual failed decode output charged before backend error propagation
No 131072-call ceiling; continuation requires consumed input or produced output

api.read: read(Request { input: Box<[u8]>, selected: bool }, &mut Budget, FnMut(Checkpoint) -> Result<(), Stop<E>>) -> Result<Completed, Error<E>>
api.budget: Budget::new(Limits), limits(), usage(), elapsed(). Caller retains the same mutable Budget across retries; no reset API. Instant starts at construction.
api.completed: Boundary { header_bytes, deflate_bytes, read_ahead_bytes, inflated_bytes, crc32, member_bytes, offered_bytes }; bytes: Option<Vec<u8>>; cumulative usage snapshot
api.unselected: None output still fully decodes and verifies. Some(empty Vec) distinguishes selected empty payload.
api.ownership: Input consumed by ownership. Output stays private until successful final check after decoder drop. Failure drops all temporary output but retains budget charges. No early sink or user-controlled decoder injection.

format: Single GZip member only; exact magic, CM=8, reserved flags clear
Consume MTIME/XFL/OS and FTEXT without interpreting them
FEXTRA u16 length and exact bytes; FNAME/FCOMMENT terminated byte fields, never paths or Unicode strings
FHCRC lower 16 bits of zlib-rs CRC32 over preceding header bytes
Raw Inflate::new(false,15); typed Status and InflateError; no dictionary supplied
Actual StreamEnd consumed-input position defines trailer. Re-read read-ahead without duplicate input charge
Trailer little-endian CRC32 then ISIZE modulo 2^32 then exact EOF; reject concatenated members and any trailing bytes including zero

limits.caller_limits: Clamp to hard caps. u64 byte limits allow zero; zero duration invalid. Caller may only lower effective caps.
limits.zero: Input=0 rejects nonempty before parsing; metadata=0 rejects first header attempt; processed=0 rejects first input charge; output=0 still allows unselected decoding and selected empty payload.
limits.metadata: Each attempted header byte is charged, including FHCRC; trailer excluded. Metadata charge can survive truncated input.
limits.processed: Header input + bytes offered to decoder including read-ahead + any fresh trailer bytes + all decoded bytes, selected or not. Input high-water is per call; processed survives retries.
limits.failed_output: Validate total_out delta <=65536 then charge actual delta even on decoder Err. A decoded overrun remains in usage and future checks reject. Input/output/metadata charges that would exceed limits fail before increment.
limits.allocation: Charge selected output before try_reserve_exact and append; failure retains charge. Buffer size <=65536. No total allocator-memory or panic/OOM recovery guarantee.

precedence: Start checkpoint (Cancelled/Deadline/Callback(E)) then shared processed/time check then input-length cap
Ordinary header check then metadata charge then byte check/EOF/input charge. FHCRC metadata charge precedes byte check as in C#
BeforeInflate checkpoint/time check; new offered-input charge before decoder call

After decoder: invalid total_out delta => Boundary; valid actual decoded charge overrun => Budget; backend Err => Backend(original InflateError); only successful backend return reaches AfterInflate checkpoint/time check
Successful call then consumed-input validation, CRC update, selected-output charge/reserve/copy, AfterOutput checkpoint
StreamEnd checks, trailer CRC mismatch => Crc before Size before TrailingData; final decoder drop then BeforeReturn checkpoint/time check
Any callback Stop::Callback(E) returned unchanged. No later checkpoints after an error. Returned first error retained through normal decoder drop.

progress.rule: Each continued decoder call must consume >0 input or produce >0 output. Refill at exhausted window only, <=65536 bytes. Empty-input drain allowed for pending output. Zero progress without StreamEnd becomes Truncated if input exhausted, otherwise NoProgress.
progress.finite: Input <=16MiB; all output charged against cumulative128MiB (at most one chunk observed overrun). No repeated zero-progress calls and no arbitrary call-count ceiling.
progress.limitations: Typed backend has no IsNeedingInput property; zero-progress classification uses supplied/consumed positions. Exact SharpZipLib malformed-stream consumption and failure-cost identity is not claimed.

checkpoint.ordering: Callback first, then Instant/processed check. Stop::Cancelled takes precedence over elapsed deadline at that check. Callback failure retains E; injected Stop::Deadline maps Budget.
checkpoint.granularity: Header checked per byte, raw input and output at <=64KiB, after output and after decoder cleanup. Callback time counts; callback/codec cannot be forcibly interrupted.
checkpoint.observability: Checkpoints expose usage, not provisional output. Stage calls are Rust API seams, not a claim of identical C# token poll counts.

errors.backend: InflateError re-export, preserved NeedDict { dict_id }, StreamError, DataError, MemError
errors.callback: Original generic E preserved; no message matching, catch/default or blanket unwind handling
errors.cleanup: zlib-rs Drop runs decoder cleanup but does not expose its return status. No external sink Dispose in this API; no claim that cleanup failures, panic or OOM are recovered.

tests.status: No regression execution in this implementation task. Separate regression owner to be assigned after fixed source head.
preserve: Budget exact boundaries/zero limits/failure charging/shared retries/cancellation/deadline/final-result discard
adapt: Partial feed and drain become adapter behavior cases, no arbitrary feed size public argument
Sink cancellation becomes checkpoint cancellation; HashSink becomes test hashing of Completed bytes
SharpZipLib backend failure becomes original typed zlib-rs error with separately tested counter/precedence behavior
not_directly_applicable: Mutable backing array with owned Box input
External sink/Dispose exception and injected inflater counter corruption
C# assembly identity, CLI, filesystem/Stream I/O
not_claimed: Existing C# 184+162 test counts or equivalent passes
Independent execution, Windows, full-product acceptance, performance or vulnerability-free dependency
